steps.title: Analyze Layout Structuring
steps.description: Evaluate the current activity_main.xml layout structure to accommodate a full-screen loading overlay via FrameLayout.

steps.title: Incorporate FrameLayout Container
steps.description: Modify the root XML tag of activity_main.xml to FrameLayout to overlay loading views seamlessly over the operational UI.

steps.title: Design Loader Screen UI Components
steps.description: Add an high-tech LCD themed loader container inside the layout XML containing booting text, progress trackers and custom segments.

steps.title: Incorporate Built-in Audio Synthesizer Class
steps.description: Implement a custom programmatic AudioTrack synthesizer class (SynthSoundPool) in MainActivity to play offline synthetic sounds without external raw files.

steps.title: Design Loader Sequence & Blip Tones
steps.description: Define beautiful arpeggiating startup chimes and rapid loading step blip tones via procedural soundwave algorithms.

steps.title: Initialize Loader Handler in MainActivity
steps.description: Bind the loading layout elements in onCreate and boot up the dynamic background thread progress indicator loop.

steps.title: Link Mechanical Key Click Sound Effects
steps.description: Integrate short tactile mechanical click audio waves on numerical entries and decimal button interactions.

steps.title: Link Operator Key Sound Effects
steps.description: Attach lower-frequency distinctive mechanical sound tones to operator click listeners like add, subtract, multiply, and divide.

steps.title: Link System Action Controls Sound Effects
steps.description: Map specific synthetic dual frequencies to administrative system inputs like clear, backspace, brackets and equals.

steps.title: Implement Smooth Transition Out of Loader
steps.description: Configure the handler post-delayed timers to dismiss the loader smoothly and launch the operational application with success chimes.

steps.title: Wipe Out External NanoHTTPD Dependency
steps.description: Clean dependencies from build.gradle ensuring strict compliance with offline built-in system standards.

steps.title: Building 3D Calculator Pro
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to compile the project successfully into a debug APK.
